articles.summary: ANTIOCH, Tenn., April 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - LKQ Corporation (Nasdaq: LKQ) will release its first quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, April 30, 2026. Conference Call Details LKQ will host a conference call and webcast on April 30, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time (7:00 a.m. Central Time) with members of senior management to discuss the Company's results. To access the investor conference call, please dial (800) 715-9871. International access to the call may be obtained by dialing (646) 307-1963. The investor conference call will require you to enter conference ID: 2118690. Webcast and Presentation Details The audio webcast and accompanying slide presentation can be accessed at ( www.lkqcorp.com ) in the Investor Relations section. A replay of the conference call will be available by telephone at (800) 770-2030 or (609) 800-9909 for international calls. The telephone replay will require you to enter conference ID: 2118690.
